Here are the detailed findings from both files.

---

## 1. The `generateTrendRadar` method -- axis labels and reference grid labels

**File:** `D:\1\daily-ai-insight-engine\src\visualize\svg-generator.ts`

The method spans **lines 294-392**.

### Axis labels

Axis labels are drawn starting at **line 341** inside the `axes.forEach()` callback. The label text element is pushed at **line 350**:

```ts
// Line 341-350
const offset = 20;
let lx = tip.x;
let ly = tip.y;
let anchor = 'middle';
if (a.angleDeg === -90) { ly = tip.y - offset; anchor = 'middle'; }
else if (a.angleDeg === 0) { lx = tip.x + offset; anchor = 'start'; }
else if (a.angleDeg === 90) { ly = tip.y + offset; anchor = 'middle'; }
else if (a.angleDeg === 180) { lx = tip.x - offset; anchor = 'end'; }

axisLabels.push(`  <text class="label" x="${lx.toFixed(1)}" y="${ly.toFixed(1)}" text-anchor="${anchor}" font-weight="bold" font-size="14">${a.label}</text>`);
```

The four axis labels are defined in the `axes` array at **lines 311-316**:

```ts
const axes: AxisDef[] = [
  { key: 'technology', label: '技术', angleDeg: -90 },
  { key: 'application', label: '应用', angleDeg: 0 },
  { key: 'policy', label: '政策', angleDeg: 90 },
  { key: 'capital', label: '资本', angleDeg: 180 },
];
```

The label positioning logic:

- **-90 degrees (top, '技术')**: offset upward by 20, `text-anchor="middle"`
- **0 degrees (right, '应用')**: offset rightward by 20, `text-anchor="start"`
- **90 degrees (bottom, '政策')**: offset downward by 20, `text-anchor="middle"`
- **180 degrees (left, '资本')**: offset leftward by 20, `text-anchor="end"`

### Reference grid labels (the "ref-labels")

Reference grid labels are drawn at **lines 352-356**, also inside the `axes.forEach()` callback. The loop variable `r` iterates over `[0.25, 0.5, 0.75]` for each axis:

```ts
// Lines 352-356
for (const r of [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]) {
  const rp = getPoint(a.angleDeg, r);
  refLabels.push(`  <text class="ref-text" x="${rp.x.toFixed(1)}" y="${rp.y.toFixed(1) + 3}" text-anchor="${a.angleDeg === 180 ? 'end' : a.angleDeg === 0 ? 'start' : 'middle'}">${r.toFixed(2)}</text>`);
}
```

Key details:
- The y-position is nudged downward by 3 pixels (`y="${rp.y.toFixed(1) + 3}"`)
- `text-anchor` varies by axis: `end` for 180 degrees (left), `start` for 0 degrees (right), `middle` for all others (top/bottom)
- The style class `ref-text` is defined in the SVG `<style>` block at **line 51**: `font-family: system-ui, ...; font-size: 10px; fill: #9CA3AF;`

---

## 2. Where exactly are the "0.25", "0.50", "0.75" reference text elements added on the axes?

The values `0.25`, `0.50`, `0.75` appear in two places:

### (A) The grid polygon loop (lines 324-330) -- used for polygon points, NOT text:

```ts
// Line 324
for (const ratio of [0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0]) {
```

This loop draws the dashed grid polygons (4 concentric rhombus shapes) at those ratios. It is only for the polygon geometry, not text.

### (B) The reference label loop (lines 353-356) -- this is where the text is actually created:

```ts
// Line 353
for (const r of [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]) {
  const rp = getPoint(a.angleDeg, r);
  refLabels.push(`  <text class="ref-text" x="${rp.x.toFixed(1)}" y="${rp.y.toFixed(1) + 3}" text-anchor="...">${r.toFixed(2)}</text>`);
}
```

Note: the values are formatted via `r.toFixed(2)`, so they appear in the SVG output as `"0.25"`, `"0.50"`, `"0.75"` (always two decimal places). The `1.00` ratio is deliberately excluded from text labels -- no "1.00" is drawn, only the 0.25, 0.50, and 0.75 tiers.

**There are 12 reference text elements total** -- 3 per axis (0.25, 0.50, 0.75) x 4 axes.

---

## 3. Full structure of the SVG output for the radar chart

The SVG is assembled at **lines 380-391** in this exact order:

```ts
const svgContent = [
  `  <text class="title" x="${w / 2}" y="40" text-anchor="middle">四维趋势雷达 — ${date}</text>`,          // Line 381: Title
  gridPolygons.join('\n'),                                                                                   // Line 382: 4 concentric dashed grid polygons (0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0)
  axisLines.join('\n'),                                                                                      // Line 383: 4 axis lines (center to edge)
  refLabels.join('\n'),                                                                                      // Line 384: 12 reference text labels (0.25/0.50/0.75 on each axis)
  axisLabels.join('\n'),                                                                                     // Line 385: 4 axis name labels (技术, 应用, 政策, 资本)
  `  <polygon points="${dataPoints.join(' ')}" fill="rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2)" stroke="#3B82F6" stroke-width="2" />`,  // Line 386: Data polygon (semi-transparent blue fill, blue stroke)
  dataLabels.join('\n'),                                                                                     // Line 387: 4 data value labels (confidence values at data points)
  `  <text class="note" x="${w / 2}" y="${h - 20}" text-anchor="middle">数据来源: Daily AI Insight Engine — ${date}</text>`,  // Line 388: Footer note
].join('\n');
```

This inner content is then wrapped by `wrapSvg()` (line 391, function defined at **lines 42-55**), which adds:

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 ${w} ${h}">
  <style>
    .title { font-family: system-ui, ...; font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; fill: #111827; }
    .label { font-family: system-ui, ...; font-size: 13px; fill: #374151; }
    .value { font-family: system-ui, ...; font-size: 13px; fill: #6B7280; }
    .note  { font-family: system-ui, ...; font-size: 11px; fill: #9CA3AF; }
    .grid  { stroke: #E5E7EB; stroke-width: 1; stroke-dasharray: 4 4; }
    .axis  { stroke: #D1D5DB; stroke-width: 2; }
    .ref-text { font-family: system-ui, ...; font-size: 10px; fill: #9CA3AF; }
  </style>
  [content]
</svg>
```

**Canvas dimensions:** `width=600`, `height=600` (defined at lines 297-298).
**Center point:** `cx=300`, `cy=300` (lines 299-300).
**Axis length:** `axisLen=200` (line 301).

**Data polygon rendering notes:**
- The data polygon points are computed at **lines 360-365** by iterating over the four axes, looking up `trends[a.key].confidence` (defaulting to 0), and converting to cartesian coordinates.
- Data value labels are drawn at **lines 368-378** at the data point position with a 12px offset direction based on the axis angle.

---

## 4. Tests related to the radar chart

**File:** `D:\1\daily-ai-insight-engine\tests\visualize\generators.test.ts`

The radar chart tests are in the `describe` block at **lines 188-220**:

| Test name | Lines | What it asserts |
|---|---|---|
| `'returns a valid SVG string'` | 192-196 | Output starts with `<svg` and ends with `</svg>` |
| `'contains four axis labels (技术, 应用, 政策, 资本)'` | 198-204 | SVG contains all four Chinese axis label strings |
| `'contains data-filled polygon'` | 206-210 | SVG contains a `<polygon` element |
| `'data points are positioned correctly with confidence values'` | 212-219 | SVG contains the raw confidence values `0.85`, `0.72`, `0.63`, `0.78` (the values from `makeSampleTrends()`) |

**Sample data used by these tests** comes from `makeSampleTrends()` at **lines 41-70**, which provides:

| Dimension | Trend | Confidence |
|---|---|---|
| `technology` | 多模态模型成为主流 | 0.85 |
| `application` | AI编程助手普及 | 0.72 |
| `policy` | 全球AI监管加速 | 0.63 |
| `capital` | AI基础设施投资激增 | 0.78 |

There are also two integration tests in `generateAllCharts` (lines 334-357) that verify `trendRadar` is a non-empty string property in the return value (line 342 and line 352-353).

**Notable absences from the test suite:**
- No test verifies the grid polygons exist (the 4 dashed `class="grid"` polygons)
- No test verifies the reference labels (`0.25`, `0.50`, `0.75`) exist
- No test verifies the axis lines exist
- No test verifies the empty/null trends case (missing dimensions)
- No test verifies the colorblind color scheme variant
- No test verifies text-anchor positioning correctness
